title: migrate: pre-fill auth-capable primary keys
description: parse_listing only reads auth capability from sub lines. 12 live pgpkeys keys (af88128) have auth on the primary itself on an accepted type; 6 of them have no reusable auth subkey, so their drafts get no SSH key and the auth-key continuity path misses them. Treat a live auth-capable primary like a subkey.
acceptance_criteria: A real gpg key with an ed25519 sign,auth primary is pre-filled with that primary's key, checked against gpg's packet dump
